versions.content: If an AtomicSwComponentType using a PortPrototype with an NvDataInterface invokes the explicit API Rte_Write and the attribute is set to true and the writing strategy storeCyclic ([SWS_Rte_04565] applies) is en- abled, the RTE shall write the associated RAM Block (s) to NV memory by calling the NvM_WritePRAMBlock function of the NvM module in the next cycle of a pe- riodic activity after the data accessed by the Rte_Write function is written back to the RAM Block (s).
